SELECT
customer_name AS organizationName, SUM(total_price) AS totalPrice
trans_type AS type, order_date AS date, code AS invoiceCode, product_name AS itemName, qty AS qty, customer_name AS organizationName, location_name AS warehouseName, qty_uom_name AS uomName, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT 'Invoice' AS trans_type, customer_id, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', customer_code, name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, order_date, so_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', code, name) FROM products WHERE id=product_id) AS product_name, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS location_name,
sales_order_details.qty + sales_order_details.qty_free AS qty,
sales_order_details.qty AS qty,
sales_order_details.qty + sales_order_details.qty_free AS qty,
(SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id=sales_order_details.sales_order_id
AND is_pos = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS trans_type, customer_id, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', customer_code, name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, order_date, cm_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', code, name) FROM products WHERE id=product_id) AS product_name, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS location_name,
(credit_memo_details.qty + credit_memo_details.qty_free) * -1 AS qty,
(credit_memo_details.qty) * -1 AS qty,
(credit_memo_details.qty + credit_memo_details.qty_free) * -1 AS qty,
(SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price * -1 AS total_price FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_details ON credit_memos.id=credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id
ORDER BY customer_name
ORDER BY customer_name, order_date
) AS result
GROUP BY organizationName

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT sales_orders.id FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_details.sales_order_id INNER JOIN products ON sales_order_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON sales_order_details.product_id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id AND pgroups.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customers ON sales_orders.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON sales_orders.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON sales_order_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id
